about_short_description.short_description: Officely helps businesses to transform their hybrid office with one tool to book desks and boost attendance, all inside Slack.

product.name: Officely
product.description: An integrated platform within Slack and Teams for booking desks, meeting rooms, and parking spaces to manage hybrid office environments.

product.name: Meeting Rooms by Officely
product.description: A tool integrated in Slack and Teams for managing meeting room bookings and availability in hybrid offices.

product.name: Parkly
product.description: A parking management system within Slack and Teams that allows employees to book office parking spaces fairly and transparently.

product.name: Flexible Work Enablement
product.description: A set of tools and strategies to manage hybrid work by providing visibility, coordination, and data-driven insights on office attendance and resource use.

product.name: Slack Attendance
product.description: A feature within Officely that tracks and displays real-time office attendance and employee work locations inside Slack.
